subject: Culture
title: Dowry and Bride Price
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Dowry and Bride Price.

hook.text: In South Sudan, a bride can cost 200 cattle. Families go into debt for decades to marry a son.

buildup.text: Bride price transfers wealth to the bride's family. Dowry does the opposite—it flows with the bride.

discovery.text: Both systems tie family honor to the transaction. A low offer insults the bride's kin publicly.

twist.text: India banned dowry in 1961, but enforcement is weak. Dowry disputes still cause thousands of deaths yearly.

climax.text: Where marriage is a contract between families, love is a bonus—not the foundation.

punchline.text: Romance rewrote marriage in some cultures only.

quiz.question: When did India officially ban dowry?
